verdict.rationale: PostHog exposes a broad public API (openapi.json), an MCP server, and a CLI that together let AI agents run trends/funnels/retention/SQL queries, manage feature flags, trigger experiments, and interact with CDP pipelines — mirroring most core UI workflows (posthog-docs-2, -19, -24, -30, posthog-probe-3, posthog-probe-4). However, there's no explicit vendor claim or independent evidence of full 1:1 parity across every UI feature (e.g., session replay playback, survey building, dashboard UI customization aren't confirmed as fully API-manageable). Missing for 10: explicit parity documentation across every UI surface, independent verification that no UI-only features exist, and confirmation for less core features like surveys/dashboards sharing via API.
